description: Source code for UCI (Uplink Control Information) allocator implementation in a 5G NR scheduler, including functions for managing HARQ ACK, CSI reports, and UCI multiplexing.

classes.name: uci_allocator_impl
classes.description: Implementation of UCI allocation logic for 5G NR scheduler, managing UCI grid, HARQ ACK, CSI, and multiplexing.

classes.name: uci_allocator_impl::slot_alloc_list
classes.description: Nested class managing list of UCI allocations per slot.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Clears UCI allocations for a given slot.

methods.name: alloc_harq_ack
methods.description: Allocates HARQ ACK for a UE in a given slot, considering constraints and CSI reporting.

methods.name: alloc_sr_opportunity
methods.description: Allocates SR (Scheduling Request) opportunity for a UE if no PUSCH grant exists.

methods.name: alloc_csi_opportunity
methods.description: Allocates CSI report opportunity either on PUSCH or PUCCH.

methods.name: multiplex_uci_on_pusch
methods.description: Transfers UCI bits from PUCCH to PUSCH for multiplexing.

methods.name: get_scheduled_pdsch_counter_in_ue_uci
methods.description: Returns the count of scheduled PDSCH transmissions for a UE in a given UCI slot.

methods.name: has_harq_ack_on_common_pucch_res
methods.description: Checks if a HARQ ACK is granted on a common PUCCH resource.
